# Groundwork

> Groundwork is a free, ungated AI readiness system for owners and operators of small and mid-sized businesses. Six standing orders you give any AI, built in sequence, produce fifteen plain-text documents your business owns; one scoped AI Operator activates at order four and runs on top of them. Foundation first. Agents later.

Groundwork was built by Adam Abdalla, an operator in Lafayette, Louisiana who runs a 27-unit shopping center and built the system for his own businesses before publishing it. Everything on this site is open: no signup, no paywall, no gated downloads, no prices. The only call to action is a free AI readiness audit.

The six standing orders are Know me (Identity), Know my information (Knowledge), Know your limits (Governance), Help me operate (the Operator), Remember (Continuity), and Improve. From activation on, the system runs one loop: capture, understand, decide, act, verify, remember, improve. Inside Order 2 sits Authority Classification: the only named, graded document-authority system built for non-technical owners, in plain files you own. Its grading logic descends from the Admiralty Code, the source-reliability system used in naval intelligence.

## Start here

- [Day One](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/day-one.html): your first 30 minutes, scorecard first, then your first document
- [The Readiness Scorecard](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/scorecard.html): 24 questions, scored in your browser, nothing collected or transmitted
- [Guide overview](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/): the whole system on one page, with every chapter linked

## The guide

- [Foundations](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/foundations.html): the concepts under every order
- [Order 1: Know me](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/identity.html): Identity
- [Order 2: Know my information](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/knowledge.html): Knowledge, including Authority Classification
- [Order 3: Know your limits](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/limits.html): Governance, the three zones
- [Order 4: Help me operate](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/operator.html): the scoped AI Operator, its scope, package, and prompt
- [Order 5: Remember](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/remember.html): Continuity
- [Order 6: Improve](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/improve.html): Measurement and the Operating Rhythm, merged
- [The Oldest Idea in Groundwork](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/lineage.html): the Admiralty Code lineage of Authority Classification
- [The Atlas Story](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/atlas.html): a real command center running on these documents, ten features
- [The Operator Dashboard](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/dashboard.html): the morning-screen pattern over the vault and the Operator, drawn as a demonstration, then the owner's own console photographed on a demonstration dataset; Atlas is the lived version
- [Field Guide PDF](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/assets/Groundwork-Program-Guide.pdf): the doctrine in one downloadable file

## The Curriculum

The Groundwork Curriculum is the capability program beside the doctrine: five LEVELS of skill you climb as a person or team, distinct from the six standing ORDERS you build once for a business. The two axes never map one to one.

- [The Curriculum](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/): the hub, with the doctrine-versus-curriculum map
- [The Reader](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/read/): the whole curriculum readable on the site, one page per module, compiled verbatim from the repo
- [Level 1: Essentials](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-1.html): thirty days from novice to competent power user
- [Level 2: Intermediate](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-2.html): agents, RAG, MCP servers, evals, cost control
- [Level 3: Advanced](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-3.html): shipping AI to real users and keeping it standing
- [Level 4: Professional](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-4.html): leading AI teams, training, safety, red-teaming
- [Level 5: Frontier](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/curriculum/level-5.html): contributing to the field
- [Curriculum repo](https://github.com/OrangeOnyx/groundwork-curriculum): the living version, MIT licensed, credit Jake Van Clief
- [The Curriculum as one book](https://github.com/OrangeOnyx/groundwork-curriculum/releases/latest/download/Groundwork-Curriculum.pdf): 613 pages, illustrated, bookmarked, printable
